name: Google Maps
description: Google Maps Platform geocoding, elevation, time zone, static maps and Street View. Directions and Distance Matrix tools use the legacy APIs, which require an eligible project with those APIs enabled.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API key
credential_fields.description: Google Maps Platform API key. Enable billing and each API used by the tools; Directions and Distance Matrix are legacy APIs.

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Convert an address to geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude)

bounds.description: Southwest and northeast corners as southLat,southLng|northLat,northLng

region.description: Two-character ccTLD region bias, e.g. fr or uk

language.description: Language code for results, e.g. en or fr

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Convert geographic coordinates to a human-readable address

language.description: Language code for results, e.g. en or fr

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Get driving, walking, bicycling or transit directions using Directions API (Legacy). Requires an eligible project with the legacy API enabled.

origin.description: Starting address, lat,lng, or Place ID prefixed with place_id:

destination.description: Destination address, lat,lng, or Place ID prefixed with place_id:

mode.description: Travel mode; Google defaults to driving

waypoints.description: Pipe-separated waypoints. To optimize order, prefix with optimize:true|, e.g. optimize:true|Lyon,France|Dijon,France

units.description: Distance unit system; Google defaults to metric

alternatives.description: Request alternative routes; only supported without intermediate waypoints

language.description: Language code for results, e.g. en or fr

tools.name: calculate_distances
tools.description: Calculate travel distances and times using Distance Matrix API (Legacy). Requires an eligible project with the legacy API enabled. Check each rows[].elements[].status as well as the top-level status.

origins.description: Pipe-separated origins, e.g. Lyon,France|Paris,France; Place IDs need the place_id: prefix

destinations.description: Pipe-separated destinations, e.g. Dijon,France|Marseille,France; Place IDs need the place_id: prefix

mode.description: Travel mode; Google defaults to driving

units.description: Distance unit system; Google defaults to metric

language.description: Language code for results, e.g. en or fr

tools.name: get_elevation
tools.description: Get elevation data for specific locations on Earth

locations.description: Pipe-separated latitude,longitude pairs, e.g. 45.764,4.8357|48.8566,2.3522; up to 512 locations

tools.name: get_timezone
tools.description: Get timezone information for a specific location and time

timestamp.description: Required Unix timestamp in seconds; supply the desired time explicitly

language.description: Language code for results, e.g. en or fr

tools.name: generate_map
tools.description: Generate a static map image with markers, paths, and custom styling

center.description: Map center as address or latitude,longitude; required with zoom when no markers or path are provided

zoom.description: Zoom level; required with center when no markers or path are provided

size.description: Image dimensions WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 600x400; standard maximum is 640x640

markers.description: Pipe-separated marker style and locations, e.g. color:red|label:L|45.764,4.8357

path.description: Pipe-separated path style and points, e.g. color:blue|weight:3|45.764,4.8357|45.75,4.85

language.description: Language code for results, e.g. en or fr

tools.name: get_street_view
tools.description: Get street view image for a specific location

size.description: Image dimensions WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 600x400; standard maximum is 640x640

return_error_code.description: Set true to return an HTTP error when imagery is unavailable, instead of a placeholder image
